title: Möbius coefficients give the expansion
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $\\varphi$ be a real-valued function on the binary cube. For each subset $S$ of the $n$ coordinates, form the coefficient $\\sum_{T\\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|T|}\\varphi(1_T)$, where $1_T$ is the binary vector equal to $1$ precisely on $T$. The resulting coefficient assignment equals the unique assignment whose numerical polynomial represents $\\varphi$.
hypotheses_covered: $\\varphi$ is a real-valued function on the binary cube
